description: This file defines the interface for the watchdog driver in the Zephyr RTOS, including structures, macros, function prototypes, and callback API definitions for configuring and controlling watchdog timers.

methods.name: wdt_setup
methods.description: Configures global watchdog settings after installing timeouts.

methods.name: wdt_disable
methods.description: Disables the watchdog instance and uninstalls all timeouts.

methods.name: wdt_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a new timeout configuration for the watchdog.

methods.name: wdt_feed
methods.description: Feeds the specified watchdog timeout to prevent reset.
